title: Federal pseudoephedrine retail quantity limits
rule_summary: For ordinary non-mail-order retail sales, federal CMEA rules limit pseudoephedrine base to 3.6 grams per purchaser per day and 9 grams per purchaser during a 30-day period.
exam_relevance: Daily and 30-day limits are independent; a sale can violate one without violating the other.

authority.name: Controlled Substances Act, retail purchase limit

numeric_facts.conditions: Per purchaser in a calendar day, ordinary non-mail-order retail sale
Per purchaser during a 30-day period, ordinary non-mail-order retail sale

exceptions: Mail-order and mobile retail vendor rules use additional or different restrictions and are outside this fixture's scope.
common_confusions: A broad option saying at least one limit is exceeded can duplicate a more specific daily-limit answer.
The quantity is measured as pseudoephedrine base rather than package weight.
verification_notes: Current eCFR section checked on 2026-08-13. 21 CFR 1314.20 was re-read on 2026-08-20: it carries the 3.6 g daily seller restriction at (a), and its only 30-day figure is 7.5 g for mobile retail vendors at (b). The 9 g per 30-day retail limit is a prohibition on the purchaser under 21 U.S.C. 844(a), which is now cited alongside it.
